note: Access Token (personal token issued when you create an app in the Developer Hub) for private apps; OAuth for public apps that access other people's data. Development workspaces are free and unlimited. Official hosted MCP server, US and EU regions only (AU not supported). Two readings on verdict/blocker: the OAuth setup page mentions redirect URLs 'will go up for review when you submit your app for review', but I did not find a page stating review is mandatory before other workspaces can install, so app_review is possible but unconfirmed. Intercom API is REST; I found no GraphQL page (the guessed URL 404'd). Dev workspace limitations text was cut off before I read it.
